final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS n_tel FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc >= 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avg_band, AVG(n_tel) AS avg_of_group_telescope_count FROM g
